messages.content: the hours fall like petals quietly recursive built from layered images of nature time memory words recur like refrains sun rain letters folds dusk clock stone tea birds bridge journeys morning sea sky river pines bread lamps tide moon hour day repeat tilt drift return counted breath after breath quietly waiting waiting for what was already there before names again and again the silence between words longer than the words themselves nothing happens everything happens at once or never moments fold into themselves a slow accumulation of nothing in particular gathered into something resembling meaning.
